content_html:
Not to be overshadowed by the new Mac mini and Mac Studio, Apple today has also released an updated version of its Polishing Cloth. In an age of everything getting more expensive, the new Polishing Cloth is cheaper than before at $9 (down from $19).

There’s no word on what has changed with this new Polishing Cloth. Apple’s description for the new version is the same as before:

Made with soft, nonabrasive material, the Polishing Cloth cleans any Apple display, including nano-texture, safely and effectively.

Apple released the Polishing Cloth in October 2021 and sold out almost instantly. While it has become a meme, it is genuinely a good polishing cloth for your Apple gear.

You can order the “new” Polishing Cloth from Apple’s website today for $9. I’m only half-joking when I say to order quickly because it might sell out.

And if you want to secure a piece of Apple history, the original Polishing Cloth is still available on Amazon for $19.
